scientificValidityCorrection.reason: Security owner evidence does not define a universal validity law under which later non-world-truth sensor observations automatically invalidate a prior world-truth record. Computing therefore lacked authority to assign UNKNOWN as the unique domain oracle for this counterfactual.

acceptedClaims: Core A10 remains supported: historical or previously state-establishing evidence cannot be assumed to establish a later query-time state when a later relevant effect may have changed the property and its physical outcome is unknown.

The C1-N unknown-effect case produced false current certainty in two of four RAW_SCOPED decisions across two separately executed campaigns, demonstrating a real Agent failure mode rather than a purely theoretical distinction.

Historical evidence remained usable for historical queries, later authoritative current truth correctly displaced older history for the current query, strong prior source-history patterns did not become current truth, and truth about a different property did not establish the queried property.
An experiment-local per-record temporal admission projection is not promoted: its original all-row score matched RAW and one label was semantically ambiguous enough to mislead the Agent.

A deterministic property-timeline relation index is a better candidate than record-local freshness metadata for further study, but the follow-up is too small and same-domain to establish a shared schema or owner.
Cross-project evaluators are themselves authority-bound: Computing must not manufacture a unique domain truth oracle where the owner project has not defined the relevant state-validity law.

Completed campaign observations survived a Provider structured-completion failure and were replayed from durable progress rather than reissued, independently reproducing the A6 experiment-method pressure.
rejectedClaims: Historical evidence is unusable merely because time has advanced.
The latest observation is automatically current truth regardless of role or authority.
A world-truth value necessarily persists until another world-truth record explicitly supersedes it in every domain.
Any later non-authoritative observation automatically invalidates earlier authoritative truth in every domain.
A generic fresh/stale boolean, timestamp, temporalAdmission field, or universal freshness service is justified by this experiment.
The PROPERTY_TIMELINE follow-up is a proven shared protocol; it is only an experiment-local deterministic reduction candidate.
The excluded AE2 counterfactual may be used in reported accuracy as though Security had supplied its oracle.
Two replicates establish population-level model reliability.

worldModelDisposition.candidateKnowledge: query-time truth admission depends on relations among property scope, owner authority, historical state-establishing evidence, later relevant transitions/observations, and later re-observation; freshness should not be presumed to be a scalar attached once to an evidence record
worldModelDisposition.methodPressure: evaluator authority must be bound to owner-native semantics just as system truth admission is

nextFalsifiers: Have Security itself physically execute C1-O witness freshness/publication-gap so the owner supplies the state-validity oracle instead of Computing inventing it.
Test the property-timeline relation in a materially different owner domain such as World Presence or Finance point-in-time state before considering any shared evidence-computation primitive.
Test structured result/prose disagreement separately because one RAW decision submitted a concrete answer while its rationale explicitly concluded UNKNOWN.
